content: In 2 John, how does the writer call himself?
explanation: He wrote to the chosen lady. “The elder, To the chosen lady and her children” (2 John 1:1, BSB)

content: In 2 John, what old command does the elder urge?
explanation: It was from the beginning. “that we love one another.” (2 John 1:5, BSB)

content: In 2 John, why was the elder overjoyed?
explanation: As the Father commanded. “I was overjoyed to find some of your children walking in the truth” (2 John 1:4, BSB)

content: In 2 John, how does the elder define love?
explanation: Love obeys God. “And this is love, that we walk according to His commandments.” (2 John 1:6, BSB)

content: In 2 John, why did the elder not write more with paper and ink?
options: He hoped to visit face to face
explanation: So their joy would be complete. “Instead, I hope to come and speak with you face to face, so that our joy may be complete.” (2 John 1:12, BSB)
